name: The Spy Revealed!
summary: You have found a muddy note in Bookie Herod's strongbox. Its account of Private Thorsen's daily routines points to an informant among the rebels in northern Stranglethorn Vale, and it is meant for Lieutenant Doren.

sections.title: A Traitor in the Ranks
sections.body: At the Rebel Camp, the note traces Private Thorsen's patrols, companions, and daily activities. Someone has watched him closely. The signature is only -M, and the detail points to a traitor living beside him in the camp.

sections.title: Reporting to Doren
sections.body: You carry the damp parchment back to the Rebel Camp and set it before Lieutenant Doren. The initialed note gives him evidence to search for an infiltrator within the rebels' own perimeter.

faq.q: What is written on the muddy note?
faq.answer: The muddy note records Private Thorsen's daily routines, including where he patrols, whom he speaks to, and how he spends his hours in camp. It bears only the signature -M.

faq.q: Where did this note come from?
aliases: where do i find the muddy note
how to start the spy revealed
faq.answer: You find the note among the contents of Bookie Herod's strongbox after unlocking it.

aliases: who do i turn the muddy note to
faq.answer: Lieutenant Doren receives the note at the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What comes next after reporting the note?
aliases: next step after the spy revealed
faq.answer: After you report the note, Lieutenant Doren continues his investigation with Patrol Schedules.

angles.text: As an Alliance rebel, you help protect your precarious foothold in Stranglethorn Vale from local threats by finding an informant.
